name: MTEC
recent: Master Tec 在 2026 年 11 月 12 日公布季度业绩，第三季净利按年增长 16.6% 至约 1000 万令吉，主要受电缆销售增加带动。同日，公司宣布签署谅解备忘录并提供财务援助。此外，公司于 10 月底出现董事会变动。
notable: 第三季净利按年增长 16.6% 至约 1000 万令吉。
risks: 董事会成员变动：MR TEE KOK HWA。
earnings: 2026 年第三季 revenue 为 199,849,000 令吉，按年增长 72.5%，按季增长 42.2%；net income 为 10,009,000 令吉，按年增长 16.6%，按季增长 19.0%；net margin 为 5.0%，低于上一季度的 6.0%。

recent_en: Master Tec announced its quarterly results on 12 November 2026, with 3Q net profit rising 16.6% year-on-year to about RM10 million, driven by higher cable sales. On the same day, the company announced a memorandum of understanding and the provision of financial assistance. The company also saw a boardroom change in late October.
notable_en: 3Q net profit rose 16.6% year-on-year to about RM10 million.
risks_en: Boardroom change: MR TEE KOK HWA.
earnings_en: For 3Q 2026, revenue was RM199,849,000, up 72.5% year-on-year and 42.2% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM10,009,000, up 16.6% year-on-year and 19.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.0%, down from 6.0% in the previous quarter.
